a.lede: Minister calls notification delay 'not acceptable' after October attack on Irish banking player Wellington IT came to light in November
a.title: Cyberattack on service provider exposes payee data at 40 Irish credit unions

b.lede: A reported cyberattack on Wellington IT has exposed sensitive information belonging to members of 50 credit unions, the majority of which are located in Ireland. [...]
b.title: Data breach impacts 40 Irish credit unions in reported IT provider hack
